name: Cursor Composer 2.5
description: Cursor's third-generation proprietary coding model, trained on 25 times more synthetic coding tasks than its predecessor. Built on Kimi K2.5 open-source base. Priced at $0.50 per million input tokens and $2.50 per million output tokens. Scores ~63% accuracy on CursorBench v3.1.
community_quotes: Same capability bracket as Claude Opus 4.7 at a fraction of the cost
The pricing gap is real regardless of how the numbers hold up in independent testing

name: Qwen 3.7 Max API
description: Alibaba's closed-weight coding model API, scoring 56.6 on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and 72.5 on SWE-Bench Verified. Priced at $2.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens. Natively supports Anthropic Messages protocol for Claude Code integration.
community_quotes: Highest-placed Chinese model on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at launch
Can be dropped into existing Claude Code harness without rewriting integration logic

name: Anthropic Self-Hosted Sandboxes for Claude Managed Agents
description: Public beta feature allowing teams to run Claude Managed Agents and execute tools within their own infrastructure, addressing enterprise data perimeter concerns. Agent orchestration loop stays on Anthropic's side while code execution stays inside customer environment. Launch partners include Cloudflare, Daytona, Modal, and Vercel.
community_quotes: The architectural gap blocking enterprise adoption is narrower than it was
Addresses what has kept enterprise teams from deploying Claude agents at scale

name: Anthropic MCP Tunnels
description: Research preview feature enabling Claude agents to connect to private internal systems and databases without requiring public endpoints. Traffic is encrypted end-to-end and routed through a lightweight gateway deployed inside private networks. Requires access approval before use.
community_quotes: Let Claude agents connect to private internal systems without public endpoints
Carries explicit as-is language and requires access approval

name: Airbin.ai
description: All-in-one AI workspace for cloud storage and file sharing with persistent AI memory. Features project memory across sessions, multi-modal generation, and cloud-based workflow executors configurable in plain English. Launched with tagline 'One workspace. One vault. Everything you need. AI that remembers your projects.'
